item.title: Charli xcx Announces Dates For 2026 North American Music, Fashion, Film Tour
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest news and trends in music. Today, we're excited to share with you the details of Charli XCX's upcoming North American arena tour. Get ready to mark your calendars, as this is going to be a show you won't want to miss!"
[Upbeat music transitions]
Host: "Charli XCX is hitting the road later this year in support of her new album, 'Music, Fashion, Film', which drops on July 24. The tour kicks off on September 11 at the Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia and will make stops in major cities like Toronto, Boston, Washington D.C., and Los Angeles, before wrapping up on October 23 at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas."
[Music transitions to a quick clip of Charli XCX's song]
Host: "The tour will also feature a special two-night stand at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, and will be supported by underscores. If you're a fan, you'll want to act fast to get your tickets. An artist presale launches on June 12, and you can sign up now to participate. Remaining tickets will go on sale later that day."
[Music transitions back to the host]
Host: "And for the first time, Charli XCX is introducing 'Angel Tickets' - a limited number of $20 seats that will go on sale in August. These tickets will be available in pairs, and 50% of the net proceeds from charity tickets will go to the Transgender Law Center. It's a great way to support a great cause and see your favorite artist live."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. Make sure to check out the tour dates and get your tickets soon. We'll catch you in the next one!"
